round: 编辑器直连取证与 QBZ 材质改绑（第四次收口）

method.route: UE editor MCP over HTTP (127.0.0.1:8000/mcp), editor process from 19:43 run session; PIE was released before capture
method.assembly: SceneTools.add_to_scene_from_asset for the rifle skeletal mesh and the magazine static mesh, both at identity transform at the origin; the magazine assets are authored in their rifle's mesh frame, so identity-in-component-space reproduces the runtime 'asset in weapon frame + seat_t^-1' mounting
method.lighting: temporary SpotLight (Intensity=2500, AttenuationRadius=400, OuterConeAngle=55, InnerConeAngle=30, CastShadows=false) because the DayNight_Lighting level was at dusk and only produced silhouettes
method.comparison: capture rifle+extended magazine, then remove the magazine actor and capture the same pose with the factory magazine; equal lighting and framing
method.cleanup: all EXTMAGCHK actors removed (find_actors leftover = 0) and the level viewport camera restored to its pre-capture pose

findings.M4: seated in the well, extension hangs below the receiver; surface reads as the same light polymer PMAG language as the factory magazine (extended band shows expected UV stretch, no re-layout)
findings.AKM: curved 7.62 magazine lengthened along its own curvature; no step at mid-body, factory floor plate and ribs, same Soviet steel material as the factory magazine
findings.QBZ: seating and curvature pass; surface failed - the receiver-coating bake on the magazine's own atlas showed mottled black patches and receiver glyphs, clearly a different surface from the factory magazine. Fixed by binding the rifle's magazine-slot material (valid because this part is the factory magazine lengthened in place with unchanged UV0). Re-captured after the change and it matches the factory magazine.

change_applied.note: M4 keeps its accepted accessory-finish material (M_M4_ext_mag); it read consistent with the factory PMAG in the same capture and was not changed.

not_done: no game run, no in-game (DrumGripAudit fixture) capture and no user real-machine acceptance
reload follow and ADS sight line still need user judgement
